title: The exact IID-factor threshold for free Ising laws on regular trees
exact_target: For every $d\geq 3$ and $\beta \geq 0$, is the free zero-field Ising measure on the d-regular tree a factor of iid exactly when $tanh(\beta )\leq (d-1)^{-1/2}$, including equality? In that range ask for a Borel factor commuting with every graph automorphism on every label input.
